text: Did you get a good look at its face, though?\nI didn’t expect a Titan to be such a li’l cutie![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: nushi_hagane_030_friend_05
text: I bet if we go in here, we’ll find more of that\nHerba Mystica it ate before.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: nushi_hagane_030_friend_06
text: Let’s go find it before that thing can regroup![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
